desc:
🍔 Welcome to Fast Food Restaurant Tycoon! 🍟

🍳 Buy and upgrade droppers to unlock tasty meals like burgers, pizza, and more!  
🧍‍♂️ Serve hungry customers by managing your own food serving lines!  
📦 Deliver meals across the map to earn valuable Delivery Points!  
🔁 Rebirth to gain powerful multipliers and climb to the top even faster!  
💾 Your progress is autosaved!

🎁 Use code 'Release' for free cash and 'Potions' for bonus boosts!

💖 Premium users earn +25% more money!  
💰 Like the game and join our group for an extra +25% money bonus!  
🌟 Private Servers are FREE, use them if you having lag!

🔗 Join the group: https://www.roblox.com/communities/35101049/Shiny-Tycoons

Tags: Tycoon, Food, Restaurant, Rebirth, Upgrade, Delivery, Droppers, Boosts, Solo, Premium, Exploration, Hamburger, Fast Food
